tile.recipes.name: Recipes
tile.recipes.desc: Search and print recipes from Mealie
settings.index.recipes.name: Recipes
settings.modules.inactive_hint.recipes: Currently hidden: no recipe manager is selected under Settings → Recipes.
settings.recipes.hint: Connects ReceiptPi to your recipe manager. The API token is stored encrypted and is never shown in plain text again.
settings.recipes.url_hint: The address you open Mealie at in your browser, including http:// and port.
settings.recipes.token_hint: Create one in Mealie under Profile → API Tokens.
settings.recipes.test_ok: Connection OK: Mealie {version}, signed in as {user}
settings.recipes.token_missing: No API token entered and none saved.
settings.recipes.url_invalid: Invalid address - please include http:// or https://.
settings.recipes.missing_fields: Mealie needs both an address and an API token.
settings.recipes.token_delete_hint: Removes the saved API token from ReceiptPi. It stays valid in Mealie until you delete it there.
recipes.not_configured_hint: No recipe manager connected yet. Set up the connection in the settings.
recipes.search.heading: Search recipes
recipes.search.label: Search term
recipes.search.hint: Searches recipe titles and descriptions, not ingredients.
recipes.search.more_results: Showing {shown} of {total} matches - try a more specific term.
recipes.random.heading: Random recipe
recipes.random.label: Ingredients (optional)
recipes.random.hint: Separate several ingredients with commas (max. 5). Leave empty for a random recipe from all of them.
recipes.random.food_not_found_suggest: There's no ingredient named exactly “{name}” in Mealie. Did you mean: {suggestions}?
recipes.random.no_recipes: There are no recipes in Mealie yet.
recipes.detail.empty: This recipe has no ingredients and no instructions.
recipes.error.not_configured: No recipe manager set up (Settings → Recipes).
recipes.error.unreachable: Mealie is unreachable - check the address and network.
recipes.error.auth: Mealie rejected the API token - check it or create a new one.
recipes.error.invalid_response: Unexpected response - is this really the Mealie address?
recipes.import.heading: Import from Mealie
recipes.import.hint: Appends the open (unchecked) items of a Mealie shopping list to this list. Existing items are kept, nothing is changed in Mealie.
recipes.import.no_lists: There are no shopping lists in Mealie.
